claimBoundary: The source-PDF arm adds geometry-bound table header and numeric-text-layer evidence as a retrieval overlay. It preserves the original Paddle OCR text, keeps unresolved cells in source context, and treats all values as structural/lexical candidates only; semantic truth and graph admission are not assessed.

metricDefinitions.rowHit: A returned chunk contains a source document label and the exact complete gold row value sequence on one line.
metricDefinitions.exactRawSourceLine: The returned chunk contains the exact frozen Paddle OCR row-body string selected by unique source-label match.
metricDefinitions.fullRawHeaderRowPacket: The returned chunk contains the exact frozen table packet text (headers plus row) from the table baseline.
metricDefinitions.rowAndHeader: The row-hit predicate succeeds and each required header token appears somewhere in the same returned chunk; this is not a same-cell or column-binding assertion.
metricDefinitions.anyPdfDerivedRangeOverlap: A cited verifiedRange overlaps any same-document PDF-derived header-map or corrected-row range.
metricDefinitions.pdfDerivedAnyRowCellAtom: The returned chunk contains at least one exact generated column/header/value atom from the source row; it is not answer-column-specific.
metricDefinitions.pdfDerivedCompleteRowBody: The returned chunk contains the entire generated corrected cell-value line for the query row.
metricDefinitions.pdfDerivedCompleteCorrectRow: The generated row line contains the gold row values and all corresponding exact cell atoms occur in one returned chunk.
metricDefinitions.pdfDerivedCompleteRowFrame: The returned chunk contains the entire generated PDF-derived row-frame range, including metadata and provenance.
metricDefinitions.commonBaselinePacketCoverage: Each count means that packet text appears in at least one native chunk; this is not an exactly-once assertion.

correctRowEvidenceUnion.definition: Per query, either the existing same-document complete-gold-row hit or an exact complete PDF-derived row-body line in a same-document top-k chunk whose PDF-derived values match the frozen gold row.
